ModMetaData.name: Wraith & Nanite Gravtech
ModMetaData.author: Vardath
ModMetaData.description:
Unofficial, non-commercial fan-made RimWorld 1.6 mod inspired by Stargate Atlantis and SG-1 themes. WNG's core gameplay is independent of third-party Stargate mods.
Requires RimWorld Biotech and Odyssey. CatCraft's Stargates!, ONAC and the RimGate/Jaffa ecosystem are optional: when present WNG can add compatible Stargate raid/travel behavior, faction interoperability and additional craft such as Jaffa/Goa'uld Al'kesh transport and Ha'tak-inspired gravship content without duplicating or taking ownership of those mods' Stargate, Goa'uld, Tok'ra or Jaffa systems.
WNG uses dependency-free optional integration surfaces and must continue loading and functioning when those third-party mods are absent.
